meta.method: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 10 m COG tiles N30W087, N30W084, N30W081, N33W087, N33W084, N33W081, N33W078, N36W087, N36W084, N36W081, N36W078 (no tile exists for N30W078), read with rasterio out_shape at 1/10 resolution (nearest-neighbour, served from the COG internal overviews; ~100 m pixels, 3600x3600 per 3-degree tile). Each polygon (WGS84, pixel-centre-in-polygon rasterization) was burned onto the decimated grid of every tile it intersects; class pixel counts were summed across tiles. Shares are class pixels / all classified pixels (classes 10-100, including water); 'pixels' is that classified total. Unclassified (0) pixels are ignored. Polygons too small to contain a pixel centre get pixels: 0 with no shares.
